title: WELP campaign manifest
description: Aligned with validate_campaign_welp.py: adds the R17 hardening_evidence pointer (welp-evidence-bundle-0.1.0-draft, campaign snapshot dates >= 2026-09-24), the closed welp-final-classification-0.4.0-draft vocabulary and dual welp-/wlep- contract prefixes. Historical-era records keep their original meaning.

gate_baseline_reasoning_state.description: Explicit gate reasoning state; required by the validator (M05) before any Phase-3 generation.

reasoning_requested.description: Reasoning control requested from the runtime (validator M06); string label or structured control object.

reasoning_effective.description: Reasoning control measured effective on the pinned runtime (validator M06); a requested-but-ignored control is recorded here as MEASURED-ineffective, never assumed effective.

requested.description: Requested serving configuration, distinct from observed effective settings.

outcome_semantics.description: CP-1 record (methodology-revision era, validator R09): declares the outcome contract and per-task triples.

phase_finish_accounting.description: Per-phase finish_reason accounting (validator R09): COMPLETE rows with missing/unknown finish are an error.

campaign_outcome.description: Campaign execution outcome (validator R11); independent of the model readiness verdict.

generation_budget.description: Generation-budget policy record (validator R12; historical era pre-2026-09-24 — the hardening era records calibration in the frozen setup instead).

deployment_lanes.description: Historical-era record (R15, the 2026-09-23 snapshot generation): prompt/profile hashes and bounded global semantic/operational ceilings. From the 2026-09-24 hardening era the pre-scoring setup's per-class calibration inside the hash-bound hardening evidence governs instead; a global-cap record is no longer required.

hardening_evidence.description: R17 hash-bound pointer (required for campaign snapshot dates >= 2026-09-24): binds the welp-evidence-bundle-0.1.0-draft evidence document; the validator re-derives gate/context/classification from it via harness/bundle.py evaluate_bundle.

path.description: Rooted relative POSIX path inside the campaign bundle directory (no leading '/', no '.' or '..' segment, no empty segment, no backslashes).

sha256.description: 64-hex SHA-256 of the referenced evidence document bytes.

classification.description: Readiness record. Historical eras pin welp-final-classification 0.2.0/0.3.x with profile-pure dimensions (R16); from 2026-09-24 the contract is welp-final-classification-0.4.0-draft and any asserted readiness/dimensions are closed-vocabulary and must equal the classification derived from the hardening evidence bundle.

readiness.description: Closed headline readiness vocabulary (welp-final-classification); blocked/failed execution carries no verdict.

dimensions.description: Closed per-dimension classification vocabulary; the bundle-derived values govern.

cache_policy.description: Measurement cache policy (validator R14; historical era pre-2026-09-24 — hardening-era cache state is measured in the frozen pre-scoring setup).

context_validation.description: Historical R13/R16 useful-context evidence: final-token placement, reserve 512 (pre-2026-09-23) or lane-specific reserves and Family A 1.2.0-draft (2026-09-23). From 2026-09-24 context execution is re-derived from the hardening evidence bundle (Family A 1.3.0-draft); a manifest record is optional.

contracts.description: Contract acceptance records; welp-* for current campaigns, wlep-* retained for frozen historical campaigns.

scorers.description: Scorer identity records: name -> {path, sha256, selftest}. 64-hex sha256 required (R10/R17); scorer welp-reliability-scorer/2 historically, /3 from 2026-09-24. Hardening-era path records are rooted relative and verified against current source bytes.

fixtures.description: Fixture identity records: name -> {path, sha256}. 64-hex sha256 required (R10/R17); hardening-era path records are rooted relative and verified against current source bytes.

reasoning_topology.description: Hash-bound reasoning topology qualification (welp-reasoning-topology-0.1.0-draft); required for campaigns under snapshots dated 2026-09-25 or later (validator R18).

additional_effort_levels.description: Required when case is D; each entry {level, control, qualification:{status, evidence, measured_differences}}.

evidence.description: {path, sha256} pointer to the frozen qualification record, rooted relative to the campaign bundle.

reasoning_profile.description: This event's Reasoning Profile identity inside its reasoning group (welp-reasoning-topology-0.1.0-draft); required for campaigns under snapshots dated 2026-09-25 or later (validator R18/R19).

profile.description: Machine profile id; a promoted effort level uses reasoning-<level> (enum extended additively).

profile_invariant_evidence.description: Explicitly marked profile-invariant records shared across sibling reasoning-profile events; every entry {kind, path, sha256, shared_across_profiles: true, note}. Behavioral evidence is never admissible here (validator R19).
